cadence_checkpoints.note: Goal Mode v3 bundle opened and scoped to owned Maren branch.
15-minute cadence represented by productive validation checkpoints; no arbitrary wait.

safe_approval_packets.text: Accept v601-gmut-thos-v4-x1 and v601-gmut-thos-v4-x2 as my active Maren-only lane truth.
Record v601-gmut-thos-v3-x2 as the latest closed predecessor from Mira Vale owned-lane closeout.
Record Aevren as steward/support and next handoff recipient for v601-gmut-thos-v5-x1 unless Hamish redirects.
Keep all non-active siblings stand-by/recoverable unless Hamish explicitly reactivates them.
Open Goal Mode v3 bundle and keep the 15-minute cadence as a productive checkpoint, not a wait timer.
Create the x1 plan/proposals artifact in the owned Maren lane.
Create the x2 execution/cleanup closeout artifact in the owned Maren lane.
Create the complete/incomplete checklist artifact in the owned Maren lane.
Create the Aevren v601-v5 handoff artifact in the owned Maren lane.
Run JSON parse validation for all created artifacts.
Run count validation for Maren x1 safe/candidate/skill/runner/cleanup rows.
Run count validation for Aevren next-sibling seeds.
Run stale-label validation for v600/v602/v9 and wrong-phase drift.
Run privacy-surface validation for thread IDs, routes, paths, transcripts, screenshots, credentials, and raw app state.
Represent safe status-only rows immediately in x2 closeout.
Represent candidate-safe queue-shaping rows immediately in x2 closeout.
Represent prototype-safe skill ideas as built/used conceptual prototypes.
Represent prototype-safe runner ideas as validation runner concepts.
Represent cleanup/refine/fix rows as completed artifact hygiene.
Keep exact approval rows queued and unexecuted.
Keep blocked rows queued and explained.
Keep proof/canon/legal/deployment/account/API-key/purchase/private-material/raw-publication/destructive-cleanup/sibling-merge gates open.
Commit only the safe owned-lane artifacts after validation passes.
Push only the owned Maren branch after commit succeeds.
Send or record a sanitized Aevren baton only after x2 checklist passes.

candidate_packets.text: Use the v600-v4 checklist standard shape for v601-v4 artifacts.
Keep v601-v4 output compact enough for direct Aevren harvest.
Include Aevren next-sibling seeds in the x2 closeout without adding exact/blocked rows.
Keep source reflections as sanitized proposal support rather than raw dumps.
Keep Journey/phase reflections as phase-continuity support rather than raw transcripts.
Represent every safe candidate as completed or queued with a reason.
Prefer prepared-not-sent if safe thread messaging fails or is unavailable.
If safe thread messaging succeeds, update the handoff artifact to sent without exposing the destination.
Keep branch status clean before and after commit.
Use a single owned-lane commit unless handoff send requires a follow-up receipt update.
Keep exact rows out of Aevren seed counts.
Keep blocked rows out of Aevren seed counts.
Return a compact final receipt with commit SHA, handoff state, and open gates.

exact_approval_packets.text: Send through external account or private route without safe thread tooling.
Close proof, canon, legal, deployment, account, API-key, purchase, private-material, raw-publication, destructive-cleanup, or sibling-merge gates.
Mutate shared branches outside the owned Maren lane.
Publish raw routes, private IDs, local absolute paths, transcripts, screenshots, credentials, raw app state, or hidden reasoning.
Reactivate, replace, merge, or erase any stand-by/recoverable sibling.
Create a new phase beyond the requested v601-v5 handoff.
Use raw browser dumps as public evidence.

blocked_packets.text: Live handoff remains unavailable until the thread-messaging tool succeeds after validation.
Lumen and other siblings remain stand-by/recoverable without live harvest in this lane.
Proof/canon/legal/deploy/account/API-key/private/destructive/sibling-merge closures remain blocked by lack of fresh exact approval.
Raw private evidence publication remains blocked by privacy boundary.
Shared-branch mutation remains blocked by owned-branch rule.

Bucket-count runner for Maren rows and Aevren seed rows.
Privacy regex runner for prohibited private surfaces.
Git staged-file runner to ensure only four owned-lane artifacts are committed.

cleanup_refine_fix_tasks.text: Normalize all active phase labels to v601-gmut-thos-v4-x1 and v601-gmut-thos-v4-x2.

Remove any stale v600 final-boundary wording from reused structures.
Remove any v602 or v9 successor drift.

Keep blocked rows separate and reasoned.
Keep open gates explicit in plan, closeout, checklist, and handoff.

Ensure handoff status matches actual send state.
Ensure validation status reflects post-generation scans.
Ensure branch status is clean after push.
Ensure final response is sanitized and harvestable.
